mapper.select: SELECT u.user_id, u.nickname, u.avatar, u.status, a.identifier, a.auth_type, i.gender, i.phone, i.email, i.birthday, i.city, i.signature FROM sys_user u LEFT JOIN user_auth a ON u.user_id = a.user_id LEFT JOIN user_info i ON u.user_id = i.user_id WHERE u.user_id = #{userId} AND u.del_flag = 0
